notes: Erudite Wizard: 'Whenever you draw your second card each turn, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' Turn 1: three draws (three Crash Throughs) give exactly one counter (the second draw; the third does not trigger). The opponent's draw on its turn does nothing. Your next turn: the draw step is the first card, the Crash Through draw is the second: a second counter. 2/3 -> 4/5. Re-pinned 2026-10-30 (V2 + B-90 (a), at the cards/integration merge): mana empties as each step and phase ends (CR 500.5), so the mana is added at the step that spends it, standing in for the lands tapped there.
